display_long_description:
Hollowdeep is a single-player VR dungeon crawler where the heroes you rescue become your party.

RESCUE YOUR PARTY
Five adventurers are locked deep below the Lantern Guild. Defeat each floor's Jailer, take his key, open the cell, and the hero joins you and hands you their weapon: dagger, bow, axe or staff.

FIGHT SIDE BY SIDE
Your companions follow you down every stair and fight beside you. Swing your sword for real and block a skeleton's blade with your own.

SIXTEEN FLOORS
The Old Cellars, the Bone Galleries, the Ember Halls and the Throne of Bones - then Act 2: twelve deeper floors through the Sunken Crypt, the Ember Forge and the Hollow Heart, down to the Lich.

WORK AS A TEAM
Stand on the runes together, hold the circle while the Mage breaks a seal, let the Rogue pick the lock. Wardens, a Bone Colossus and the Lich guard the way.

MORE TO FIND
Smash barrels, beware of mimic chests, and gather twelve Lantern Shards to forge the Lantern Blade. Spend your gold at the Guild on potions and team upgrades.

MADE FOR VR
A glowing path always shows where to go next. Smooth stick walking, snap turning, a jump on A and a left or right sword hand.

Controls: left stick to walk (click to run), right stick to snap turn, A jumps, B switches weapons, X drinks a potion, Y shows the wrist board, left MENU opens the menu.
